exposure: stepped care trauma-focused cognitive behavioral therapy (SC-TF-CBT)
cohort: A total of 53 children aged 3-7 years experiencing posttraumatic stress symptoms (PTSS) were randomly assigned to receive either SC-TF-CBT or TF-CBT.
finding: Stepped care trauma-focused cognitive behavioral therapy (SC-TF-CBT) was comparable to standard TF-CBT in effectiveness for reducing PTSS and secondary outcomes, while significantly lowering delivery costs.
